title: Nathan Smith:
title_short: Nathan Smith (CEO) · People Just Need a Chance
headline: CASS's CEO says homelessness is not only the person on the street corner: it is families who lost a job, and with some stability they are right back on track. People just need a chance.
story: Nathan opens on what CASS taught him: people experiencing homelessness take their opportunities too. They also want a shot.
Then the part people miss: families. CASS runs a 30-unit emergency shelter for families. Many were barely making it by, lost a job, and had to hit the streets with their kids.
Turn: with resources and stability they are right back on track. Proof: a woman at The Haven found the right job and moved into housing of her own. Button: people just need a chance.
do: Open on <q>They also want a shot.</q> with the hook text on screen at 0:00.
Put the question on screen before his answer (CASS staff-video rule).
Keep <q>Theirs are,</q> so the viewer knows he is telling a family's story.
Use the side angle (C4899) to hide every join.
End on his face: <q>People just need a chance.</q>
dont: Only the lines on this page: the brief leaves out his business story and the rebranding aside.
No dinner footage (client rule for staff videos).
No resident's face clear in any B-roll.
No logo before the end card.
Nothing somber: the families row turns to hope right after.
